collection.name: Game Servers
collection.description: Multiplayer dedicated game servers powered by SteamCMD and native game engines
collection.author: Midnight Team

shard.name: Counter-Strike 2
shard.description: Valve's Counter-Strike 2 dedicated server built on the Source 2 engine with sub-tick updates and dynamic lighting.
shard.author: Valve & Midnight Team
shard.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
# Counter-Strike 2 Dedicated Server Installation Script for Midnight Panel
set -e
apt update && apt install -y curl lib32gcc-s1 ca-certificates

cd /tmp
mkdir -p /tmp/steamcmd
cd /tmp/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz "https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz"
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz

echo "Installing Counter-Strike 2 (App ID 730)..."
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update 730 validate +quit

cd /mnt/server
chmod +x ./game/bin/linuxsteamrt64/cs2
echo "Counter-Strike 2 installation completed!"

variables.name: Starting Map
variables.description: Default map to load on server launch (e.g. de_dust2, de_mirage, de_inferno).

variables.name: Game Type
variables.description: Game type integer (0 = Classic, 1 = Gun Game).

variables.name: Game Mode
variables.description: Game mode integer (0 = Casual, 1 = Competitive, 2 = Wingman).

variables.name: Steam GSLT Token
variables.description: Game Server Login Token created at https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers (App ID 730).
